svg.aria-label: Definitions first, then the operator: 1. Fetch: Flux pulls the prometheus-operator-crds OCI chart at the tag pinned in ocirepository.yaml, every ten minutes. 2. Apply: The HelmRelease installs the CRDs with no values set, so the chart's defaults are the whole configuration. 3. Use: The operator in kube-prometheus-stack reconciles Prometheus from these definitions. Monitors and rules in every namespace depend on them.
